name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena Petrović's journey in motorsport began in Belgrade, tinkering with go-karts as a teenager. Her passion led her to a degree in mechanical engineering, after which she honed her skills in various European racing series before making the jump to NASCAR. She joined Hendrick Motorsports a decade ago and has since been a key figure in multiple championship-winning campaigns.

Milena's approach is characterized by a relentless pursuit of data-driven optimization combined with an intuitive understanding of vehicle dynamics. She excels at translating driver feedback into actionable adjustments, always striving for the perfect balance. Her creative thinking and ability to see the bigger picture make her invaluable when facing difficult challenges on the track. Though collaborative, she is fiercely independent when it comes to problem-solving.

What sets Milena apart is her ability to thrive under pressure and her unwavering commitment to innovation. She's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and is constantly seeking new ways to improve performance, often working late into the night analyzing data and formulating new strategies. Her colleagues sometimes joke that she can predict the weather based on the vibrations of the car, but her uncanny ability to anticipate issues before they arise is no laughing matter to the competition.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Milena is a slender woman with a focused gaze and perpetually grease-stained hands.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically against her teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout race weekends.
